s001: Mum gently shakes a few treats from the packet into her palm, smiling fondly, while the cat stays seated at her feet looking up with tired, slow blinks and drooping ears. Static camera.
s002: The cat winces and a couple of kibble pieces drop from his mouth onto the floor, his jaw trembling slightly, while in the background Mum tilts her head with a puzzled frown. Static camera.
s003: The fire flickers softly below as the cat stays seated beside the clock, gazing at it wearily and slowly rubbing his paw against his jaw with a tired sigh. Slow camera push-in.
s004: The cat quickly snaps the treat from Mum's palm and starts chewing, while Mum keeps her open hand in place and smiles warmly at him. Static camera.
s005: The cat slowly rubs the side of his face back and forth against the chair leg, eyes squeezed shut and mouth twisted in discomfort, while the fire flickers softly behind him. Static camera.
s006: The cat gently paws at his mouth twice with one front paw, mouth half open and eyes glistening with distress, staying seated on the rug while the fire flickers behind him. Static camera.
s007: The cat chews slowly on one side of his mouth, head tilted, one eye squeezed shut and whiskers twitching with each careful, painful bite. Slow camera push-in.
s008: The cat slowly nuzzles his sore cheek against the cold glass, eyes closed and breathing wearily, as raindrops trickle down the outside of the window. Slow camera push-in.
s009: The cat sits slumped and still, slowly blinking his sad, tired eyes at the camera and lowering his head slightly with a small, defeated sigh. Slow camera push-in.
s010: Slow, subtle motion: the green particles at the gumline shift and settle deeper into the crevice, the tooth surface glistens under the rim light, and the gum barely trembles. Slow camera push-in.
s011: The cat holds his mouth wide open with a slight jaw tremble, the yellow tartar on his teeth glistening and the inflamed gums throbbing faintly, his eyes fixed and uneasy. Slow camera push-in.
s012: The cat finishes a big yawn toward Mum's face as a faint green haze drifts from his mouth, and Mum leans back, squinting and pressing her hand over her nose. Static camera.
s013: The cat turns his head away from the bowl and takes one slow, listless step, staying in the centre of the frame, while Mum watches him with a worried face and clasped hands. Static camera.
s014: The cat sleeps curled on the rug, his body rising and falling with slow, shallow breaths and one ear twitching once, while the fire flickers gently in the background. Slow camera push-in.
s015: Mum gently strokes the cat in her lap with a soft, understanding smile as he looks up at her and slowly blinks. The tub stays completely still with its label facing the camera. Static camera.
s016: Mum's hands let go of the tub and slowly withdraw, while the cat stares at it with wide, shining, hopeful eyes and his ears prick up. The tub stays completely still with its label facing the camera. Static camera.
s017: Mum tips the scoop and a fine stream of powder sprinkles gently onto the food in the bowl, while the cat watches closely with bright, eager eyes. The tub stays completely still with its label facing the camera. Static camera.
s018: Slow, subtle motion: glistening saliva gently spreads across the teeth and tongue, a thin strand stretching softly, while the cat's jaw trembles slightly and his eyes stay calm. Slow camera push-in.
s019: Slow, subtle motion: the glossy saliva droplet slowly slides along the gumline and seeps down into the gap, coating the tooth as the small green particles gently dissolve. Slow camera push-in.
s020: Slow, subtle motion: the yellow tartar on the teeth slowly cracks and flakes away, revealing cleaner white enamel, while the cat holds his mouth open with a slight jaw tremble. Slow camera push-in.
s021: Slow, subtle motion: the pink gums glisten healthily as the cat relaxes into a gentle, contented smile, his eyes softening and his whiskers twitching slightly. Slow camera push-in.
s022: The cat lies on his back with a blissful smile, his belly rising and falling slowly, paws curling and stretching lazily as warm sunlight glows over him. Static camera.
s023: The cat leans slightly toward the bowl, sniffing with a dreamy, delighted smile and half-closed eyes, as soft wisps of steam rise from the food. Slow camera push-in.
s024: The cat keeps his front paws on Mum's knee, gently kneading and gazing up pleadingly, while Mum laughs warmly and shakes her head. The tub stays completely still with its label facing the camera. Static camera.
s025: The cat leans slightly toward the camera with an excited, mischievous grin, raising his eyebrows and twitching his whiskers, staying seated on the rug as the fire flickers behind. Slow camera push-in.
s026: The cat sits happily behind the tubs, smiling, blinking and gently swishing his tail, staying seated in the centre. The tubs stay completely still with their labels facing the camera. Static camera.
s027: The cat smiles at the camera and gently taps his raised paw downward twice toward the bottom of the frame, staying seated beside the tub. The tub stays completely still with its label facing the camera. Static camera.
